project_context.emotion_and_vibe: Authority, Precision, Efficiency, Command-Center. The UI must feel like a high-end logistics terminal—clean, legible, and data-dense.
project_context.theme_preference: Light theme preferred, optimized for brightly lit office environments.

design_system.theme_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with The Performance Pro. Prioritize structural grayscale, high-legibility, and functional color coding.

background.app: bg-slate-50 (#F8FAFC) - tinted light gray to prevent eye strain
background.surface: bg-white (#FFFFFF) - for clear separation of content
background.sidebar: bg-slate-900 (#0F172A) - dark sidebar for command-center focus

text.primary: text-slate-900 (#0F172A) - near black for maximum contrast
text.secondary: text-slate-500 (#64748B) - for metadata and table headers

brand.primary: bg-blue-600 (#2563EB) - Trustworthy blue for primary actions

status_system.danger: bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 (for urgent, delayed, or unpaid)

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist (Tech/SaaS variant) - Radical legibility for data.

data_and_metrics.usage: Use for Quote IDs, VIN numbers, Tracking Numbers, Prices, Dates.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics). Density, Data Correlation, Scanability.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12 for complex views. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous internal padding for structural containers (p-6 or p-8). Compact padding for data cells (px-4 py-3).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for dense content, tables, and forms. Center only for empty states.

surface_and_borders.strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton.
surface_and_borders.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), subtle soft shadow (shadow-sm). No heavy drop shadows.
surface_and_borders.radius: Subtle roundness, max 8px (rounded-lg) for outer containers. rounded-md for buttons/inputs.

component_library.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Forms must look highly structured. Stacked labels with crisp inputs.
component_library.tables: MANDATORY: High-density data tables. Implement sticky headers, hover state on rows (hover:bg-slate-50), and clear pagination.
component_library.badges: Use rounded-md badges with soft backgrounds and bold text for status indicators.
component_library.buttons: Rectangular with slight radius (rounded-md). Clear hover states.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST have explicit hover states. Table rows highlight, buttons slightly darken.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transitions: 'transition-colors duration-200', 'transition-transform duration-200 ease-out'. DO NOT use 'transition-all'.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Add a pulsing green dot animation for 'Live Orders' status to indicate real-time tracking.

images.description: A semi-truck traveling along a highway with snow-capped mountains. Ideal for the left or right split-screen of the login/register page.
Aerial shot of cargo containers. Good for empty states in the tracking or orders section.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 or 2 for crispness. Use icons in sidebars, table actions, and metric cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Avoid light gray text on white backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='create-quote-btn').

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment. Data tables should have right-aligned numbers/prices and left-aligned text.
Design for scale: assume the user has 100+ active orders. Tables need to be scan-friendly.
Never use full-screen gradients. Use solid structural colors to guide the user's eye.
Dashboards should have a fixed sidebar and a scrollable main content area with a sticky header.
Always apply a `hover:text-*` explicitly to prevent color drop-off.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Use Shadcn UI with standard .js/.jsx extensions. Customize the `tailwind.config.js` with the specified fonts (Manrope, IBM Plex Sans).
instructions_to_main_agent.structure: Build a master layout with a Sidebar Navigation and a Topbar (for user profile and notifications).
instructions_to_main_agent.key_views: 1. Dashboard Metrics (Bento grid), 2. High-density DataTable for Leads/Orders, 3. Quote Calculator Form.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_test_ids: Enforce `data-testid` on all buttons, links, form inputs, and major containers.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where applicable.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Components MUST use named exports. Pages MUST use default exports.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx` or `.js`.
